checks.command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-beads.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -r "$tmp"' EXIT; (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" beads --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -q 'Commands that help maintain the bd issue tracker' "$tmp/help"; if "$tmp/ao" beads verify >"$tmp/rejected.out" 2>"$tmp/rejected.err"; then exit 1; fi; test ! -s "$tmp/rejected.out"; grep -qx 'Error: accepts 1 arg(s), received 0' "$tmp/rejected.err"; mkdir -p "$tmp/repo/.beads" "$tmp/bin"; git -C "$tmp/repo" init -q; printf '%s
' '#!/usr/bin/env bash' 'printf "%s
" "$*" >>"$TRACE_FILE"' 'printf "[]
"' >"$tmp/bin/bd"; chmod +x "$tmp/bin/bd"; (cd "$tmp/repo" && PATH="$tmp/bin:$PATH" TRACE_FILE="$tmp/trace" "$tmp/ao" beads tracker --json >"$tmp/tracker.json"); jq -e '.tracker == "bd" and .source == "ledger" and (.ledger_dir | endswith("/.beads"))' "$tmp/tracker.json" >/dev/null; (cd "$tmp/repo" && PATH="$tmp/bin:$PATH" TRACE_FILE="$tmp/trace" "$tmp/ao" beads exec ready --json >"$tmp/exec.json"); grep -qx 'ready --json' "$tmp/trace"; jq -e 'type == "array" and length == 0' "$tmp/exec.json" >/dev/null
